method.startup: process launch to visible launcher input; includes Playwright overhead; OS caches not cleared
method.wake: main-process show() duration until synchronous reveal completes, not display photon latency
method.searchIpc: renderer clock from invoke to first progress (or final on before) and final response; excludes 60 ms UI debounce
method.searchUi: DOM input event to first matching command observed on requestAnimationFrame; includes debounce
method.clipboardOpen: DOM click to first non-empty rendered clipboard rows, observed on requestAnimationFrame
method.scroll: 120 animation frames moving through the history; no forced GC
method.memory: sum of OS RSS for app.getAppMetrics PIDs; shared pages may be counted more than once
